options.label: Enable
options.description: On: four more tabs in the Archives screen of the in-game menu (Completion, Story, Zones and Dylan), with one completion bar and a count for each kind of thing to do or find. Takes effect when the game starts.

options.label: Names of missing story things
options.description: When the pages name the main story missions, side stories and enemy research entries you have not done yet. Other missing things follow their own settings.

options.label: Hide story totals
options.description: On: Main Story Missions and Side Stories show ?? as their total until all of them are done, like 25 / ??.

options.label: Zones not visited yet
options.description: How the lists by zone show a zone you have not been to yet.

options.label: Hide names of locked items
options.description: On: Artifacts and clothes you have not unlocked show as ??? in the lists of missing ones, next to where they come from. A missing ability shows as ??? until its Resonant is defeated.

options.label: Show unlock hints
options.description: On: a missing Artifact, clothing piece or ability says where it comes from, such as a zone level, a vendor or a side story. Off: these hints read ??? instead.
